summary: WalkEdges::next_neighbor returned the starting endpoint instead of the neighboring endpoint: the source for outgoing walks and the target for incoming walks. The fix selects the opposite endpoint using 1 - self.direction as usize. The fix-added walk_edges test in tests/ograph.rs detects the bug because its outgoing traversal computes zero edge weights instead of target-minus-source differences. No builds or tests were run.
expected_failure: Assertion failure at assert_eq!(gr[e0], 1.): actual edge weight 0.0, expected 1.0.
